races.name: Modern Games Darley Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
HUMIDITY's juvenile form reads very well now, so it would be no surprise if he defied a year-long absence to further enhance the 3-y-os' excellent recent record in this race. Solid yardstick The Lost King can offer most resistance.

  1. HUMIDITY
  2. THE LOST KING
  3. BOILING POINT (IRE)

races.name: Native Trail Zetland Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
All of these look progressive but DRUMBEAT is the clear pick on form after his third in the Beresford Stakes at the Curragh 2 weeks ago. Likely front runner Sword Salute is feared most.

  1. DRUMBEAT (IRE)
  2. SWORD SALUTE (USA)
  3. APULIA BAY (IRE)

races.name: Emirates Autumn Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
ROCK MONTREAL took a while to hit full stride and conceded first run but was noted finishing strongly when finding only one too good in listed company at Doncaster 4 weeks ago. He remains potentially smart, not least now tackling 1m for the first time and he rates a major player on his foray into Group company. Sergei Diaghilev found only Godolphin's Desert Castle too good in the Champagne Stakes and he's a major threat with the promise of more to come.

  1. ROCK MONTREAL (IRE)
  2. SERGEI DIAGHILEV (IRE)
  3. AL JABBAR (IRE)

races.name: Darley Dewhurst Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
Having impressed when scoring on debut, DESERT CASTLE took the rise in class in his stride and looked a high-class colt in the making when impressively following up in the Champagne Stakes at Doncaster 4 weeks ago. Open to further improvement, he shades preference over Darkness Falls who is similarly improving at a rate of knots and already has a comfortable success at Group 1 level to his name. Great Barrier Reef can fill out third.

  1. DESERT CASTLE
  2. DARKNESS FALLS (IRE)
  3. GREAT BARRIER REEF (IRE)

races.name: Club Godolphin Cesarewitch Handicap (Heritage) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NAVAL TRIBUTE has been most progressive since stepped up to 2m and is taken to pull out even more for this slightly longer trip and make it 5-7 in handicaps for his excellent trainer. Mountain Road could have fared better with the draw but is another who has really got back on the up since faced with 2m again and is second choice ahead of Sea Lantern, who is very much the unknown quantity, and last year's 1-2 Beylerbeyi and Dawn Rising.

  1. NAVAL TRIBUTE
  2. MOUNTAIN ROAD (FR)
  3. SEA LANTERN

races.name: Triple Time Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CULLENAGH RAINBOW's debut form has been well advertised, and she could make her experience count second time up. Probing is the sole runner with a Group 1 entry and is very much respected, along with fellow newcomer Desert Romance, whose powerful yard has an excellent recent record in this maiden.

  1. CULLENAGH RAINBOW (IRE)
  2. PROBING
  3. DESERT ROMANCE

races.name: Dubai Racing Club Nursery
races.verdict:
Some interesting types in this finale but Charlie Appleby's improving NATIONAL HONOUR looks to have got in lightly for his nursery debut so is hard to oppose in his hat-trick attempt. Both Majestic Jude (second choice) and Silver Sovereign also arrive on the up and bidding for hat-tricks and command plenty of respect. Handicap debutant United Authority completes the shortlist.

  1. NATIONAL HONOUR (IRE)
  2. MAJESTIC JUDE (IRE)
  3. SILVER SOVEREIGN

races.name: DragonBet Best Odds Guaranteed Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting will likely prove most informative but fairly useful Flat winner CONFUSED appeals as a likely type on paper starting out for the Faye Bramley yard and with the booking of Harry Cobden an obvious plus, he could be the way to go. Sacre Chef was a comfortable winner of his sole start on the Flat in France and commands clear respect debuting for Dan Skelton, whilst Tokyo Tower is another likely type judged on his Flat exploits in Ireland.

  1. CONFUSED (IRE)
  2. SACRE CHEF (FR)
  3. TOKYO TOWER (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow 'Four Years Old' Hurdle (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Having landed the Scottish Triumph Hurdle at Musselburgh in January, MADE U BLUSH twice shaped well in handicaps thereafter, latterly when doing best of those from off the pace when fifth in the Swinton at Haydock in the spring. This has likely been her target since and she can exploit a handy-looking mark with the prospect of more to come. This is competitive though, with Way of Stars, Gallivanted, Treasure Planet and Tenter le Tout just a quartet of others to consider.

  1. MADE U BLUSH
  2. WAY OF STARS (IRE)
  3. GALLIVANTED (FR)

races.name: DragonBet Backing Welsh Racing Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton continues in fine form and his HITINTHEHEADLINES is fancied to take a sizeable step forward now stepped up in trip and make a winning start over hurdles. Stick To The Board looked a good prospect when landing a bumper here in the spring and rates a major danger though, while Great Dance has the form to play a big part too. Fromjago'stomilan and Nimba are other hurdling debutants to consider in a fascinating maiden.

  1. HITINTHEHEADLINES (IRE)
  2. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE)
  3. GREAT DANCE (FR)

races.name: McCarthy Construction Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A case can be made for lots of these but the vote goes to ONLY ONE BLUE who returns on a handy-looking mark for her in-form handler with this step up in trip also looking a plus. Dan Skelton's Miss Cynthia resumes on the back of a breathing operation and heads the list of dangers, while Kosasiempre and Flash Bardot also need considering.

  1. ONLY ONE BLUE (IRE)
  2. MISS CYNTHIA
  3. KOSASIEMPRE (FR)

races.name: Wasdell Group Silver Trophy Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MASKED MAN created a fine impression when successful at this fixture 12 months ago, and he may be able to repeat the feat for his bang-in-form stable. Daylatedollarshort and The Mighty Celt are likely improvers for excellent yards, while Kocktail Bleu and Washington also appeal in an ultra-competitive renewal.

  1. MASKED MAN (FR)
  2. DAYLATEDOLLARSHORT (IRE)
  3. THE MIGHTY CELT (IRE)

races.name: DragonBet John Ayres Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A very competitive handicap that may go the way of GOLD FOR ALEC, who finished last season on a high and should be spot on for this following a pipe-opener. He's narrowly preferred to in-form Torrent, with the returning Magical King also respected for a yard among the winners. Got A Dream and Faded Fantasy complete the shortlist.

  1. GOLD FOR ALEC (FR)
  2. TORRENT
  3. MAGICAL KING (IRE)

races.name: LSL Racing Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Irish point winner NORTHERN SINGER gets the nod to make a successful start to her Rules career for Dan Skelton, with confidence increased should the betting vibes be strong. Ludlow winner Milly Ocean may give her most to do unless the betting vibes are strong surrounding Nigel & Willy Twiston-Davies newcomer Iconic Elsa.

  1. NORTHERN SINGER (IRE)
  2. MILLY OCEAN (IRE)
  3. ICONIC ELSA

races.name: Project Rugby Community Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FINISK PRIDE shaped like a stayer while displaying plenty of ability in a pair of Ayr bumpers and upped in trip on hurdling debut, he can master the standard-setting Presentandcorrect.

  1. FINISK PRIDE (IRE)
  2. PRESENTANDCORRECT (IRE)
  3. NORTHERN MILAN (IRE)

races.name: Hitz Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BOGHA BAISTE shades the vote over Dark Tide Rising in a very winnable novice. Hourman is best of the others.

  1. BOGHA BAISTE (IRE)
  2. DARK TIDE RISING (IRE)
  3. HOURMAN (FR)

races.name: Tackling Insights Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hopefully some rain arrives for MEDIEVAL GOLD, who's well treated on his best form and looked back on song at Perth last time. Rebel Tribesman makes a 600-mile round trip for a yard with an excellent course record and has to be feared.

  1. MEDIEVAL GOLD
  2. REBEL TRIBESMAN (IRE)
  3. HEATHER HONEY

races.name: Cast Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PASSING DIAMOND has made a fine start to his career over fences and has leading claims to make it a hat-trick. Interesting chasing debutant Tiddesley Wood is feared most, in a race where it's hard to rule out any of the quartet.

  1. PASSING DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. TIDDESLEY WOOD
  3. PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE)

races.name: Blaydon Races Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ATHAIR MOR did well over fences last season and can make a winning start for an in-form yard. Prospect House is an obvious threat under a penalty after his stylish win at Uttoxeter last week, while Langton Wold looks interesting back over fences.

  1. ATHAIR MOR (IRE)
  2. PROSPECT HOUSE (IRE)
  3. LANGTON WOLD (IRE)

races.name: Tynedale RFC Community Rugby Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There may well be more to come from lightly-raced chaser GETAWAY VIC. He still looked rough around the edges when scoring at Sedgefield and is taken to confirm that form with Jeteye, who continues to thrive for the in-form Sam England yard.

  1. GETAWAY VIC (IRE)
  2. JETEYE (IRE)
  3. RIBEYE

races.name: Clubs Of Northumberland Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
I'VE GOT A FRIEND looks set for a decent future under Rules for all he was fortunate to win first-time out at Worcester, and there's a good chance he'll have the run of things again up against newcomers. The market should offer clues regarding the others, with Irish-raider The Gloves Are Off a tentative second choice.

  1. I'VE GOT A FRIEND (IRE)
  2. THE GLOVES ARE OFF (IRE)
  3. PETHER'S DAISY

races.name: Carlsberg Danish Pilsner 1847 Handicap
races.verdict:
DUMFRIES has been shaping up well for a while now and this could be the day where he puts it all together. Green Icon has never really been one for maximum faith but he got the job done last time and remains well treated, while veteran Al Suil Eile also merits a second look.

  1. DUMFRIES
  2. GREEN ICON (FR)
  3. AL SUIL EILE (FR)

races.name: Erdinger Weissbier Stein Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider but PRINCE RASAM's all-weather record is a pretty good one and the strong feeling is that he can win a race from his current mark. With stall 2 another plus he gets the vote in favour of Izzari and R P McMurphy, who finished 1-2 over C&D recently. Irish raider Calm The Jets needs a check in the market.

  1. PRINCE RASAM
  2. IZZARI (GER)
  3. R P MCMURPHY

races.name: Britvic Biergarten Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MARRWAA is bred to be useful and while her successful stable has had just the one winning 2-y-o newcomer this season, she is selected to double that tally in the hope the market vibes are positive. Diamondsforyou, Ruby Sands and Lizzie Bennet have all displayed ability and can make their presence felt.

  1. MARRWAA
  2. DIAMONDSFORYOU (IRE)
  3. RUBY SANDS

races.name: Brooklyn Ground Works Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARABIAN SUMMER hasn't been seen for a couple of years but this doesn't look the deepest of races and she could reward connections for their patience upped to a trip that will suit. Stablemate Light Snowfall is interesting on debut so the market will likely prove really informative here, while Graniteville has an experience edge that should see her figure.

  1. ARABIAN SUMMER (IRE)
  2. GRANITEVILLE (IRE)
  3. LIGHT SNOWFALL

races.name: Pepsi Max Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
PICKERSGILL often doesn't settle but she seems to save her best for this track and is now back down to last winning mark so she's worth chancing with a positive ride likely in a race that looks short on natural early speed. Go Lockers Go is the obvious alternative but has a 5 lb higher mark to contend with, while Wise Crack is another that should go well.

  1. PICKERSGILL (IRE)
  2. GO LOCKERS GO
  3. WISE CRACK (IRE)

races.name: Pepsi Max Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
WILLOLARUPI is a C&D winner from not many attempts on all-weather and also ran well when second here recently so he could have more to offer on this surface and is preferred over the well-treated Jesse Luc, who needs luck given his style, while Eightthreeone holds strong claims having escaped a penalty for recent success, too.

  1. WILLOLARUPI (IRE)
  2. JESSE LUC
  3. EIGHTTHREEONE

races.name: Pilsner To The Post Handicap
races.verdict:
TANJEN has been going through a good spell of late, finding further improvement when winning comfortably at Hamilton last time, and she is taken to add to her tally. Next best could be Goyard, who got back on track when runner-up here on his latest outing, with Rogue Bullet completing the shortlist.

  1. TANJEN (IRE)
  2. GOYARD (IRE)
  3. ROGUE BULLET (IRE)

races.name: Beerly A Winner Handicap
races.verdict:
COSMO BROWN shaped promisingly when making the frame at Bath recently and with this step up in trip likely to unlock more, he could be the answer for a yard among the winners. L'Eagle Aid is feared most.

  1. COSMO BROWN (IRE)
  2. L'EAGLE AID (IRE)
  3. DUST COVER

races.name: Gents Night Saturday 24th October Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for FLIGHTOFTHEPHOENIX, who was unlucky not to finish even closer when third over this C&D a fortnight ago. She looks up to adding to her 2 wins in August, though Domination has been proving consistent and isn't taken lightly with headgear applied. Dream Harder and Masterly are also considered.

  1. FLIGHTOFTHEPHOENIX (IRE)
  2. DOMINATION (IRE)
  3. DREAM HARDER (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Rockingham Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
CUT A DASH races outside of Group company for the first time since his course debut success in the spring and is narrowly preferred to Gimcrack fourth Agamemnon. Divine Whisper and Dubai Champion are next on the list.

  1. CUT A DASH
  2. AGAMEMNON
  3. DIVINE WHISPER

races.name: Sky Bet For The Fans Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider but an opening mark of 94 may underestimate SHADOW ROAD, who gave a very smart prospect a decent race at Kempton last month. Nobody Knows, Water To Wine and Stoneacre Donny can make it a clean sweep for the 3-y-os.

  1. SHADOW ROAD (IRE)
  2. NOBODY KNOWS (IRE)
  3. WATER TO WINE (FR)

races.name: Sky Bet Peter Nolan Handicap
races.verdict:
Low-mileage 3-y-o WEFFAAG didn't need to improve when opening his account in a 6-runner maiden at Newcastle 3 weeks ago and with the third that day having advertised the form since, William Haggas's colt looks potentially well treated from an opening mark of 79 now handicapping. Frankies Dream needs things to drop right but he lurks on a handy mark so is feared. Last-time-out winners Canvas and Nyman are others to consider, with Metallo another to note.

  1. WEFFAAG
  2. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE)
  3. CANVAS

races.name: Sky Bet Sprint Trophy Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
Andrew Balding's OLD IS GOLD has proved a different model since the visor went on and this front runner can make light of a 9 lb weights hike for his easy Newmarket success and complete a quick hat-trick. Ayr Gold Cup hero Pellitory continues in fine form and heads a long list of dangers with last year's winner Binhareer also a likely player. Coul Angel, Fine Interview, Toyotomi and Grasmere Boy all command plenty of respect too in this cracking sprint.

  1. OLD IS GOLD (IRE)
  2. PELLITORY
  3. BINHAREER (IRE)

races.name: Dementia Forward U&Me EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
William Haggas took this 12 months ago and can repeat the feat with his Cracksman colt IRON STONE LAD, who shaped well when running on late into second at Newbury on his recent debut and can take a sizeable step forward with his stamina unlocked more here. The Gosdens' Camelot newcomer National Anthem is bred to be useful and must enter calculations, while Coloniser, who finished a couple of places behind the selection at Newbury, is also very much one to consider.

  1. IRON STONE LAD
  2. NATIONAL ANTHEM
  3. COLONISER (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Extra Places Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ALFRED WINCHAM took a step forward on his handicap debut when runner-up at Doncaster last time, pulling clear with a pair of 3-y-os, and he is open to further progress as he goes up in trip. Representing a yard among the winners over jumps, he gets the vote ahead of the in-form Spirit of Acklam and Cascade Hall.

  1. ALFRED WINCHAM (IRE)
  2. SPIRIT OF ACKLAM
  3. CASCADE HALL (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BE THE STANDARD looks far from exposed on his first try over 1¼m and he could be the answer in a very tricky handicap. Double Parked has some solid course form and is a danger if putting his best foot forward, while a strong pace could bring Per Contra, Ashnak and Almekarem into the mix.

  1. BE THE STANDARD (FR)
  2. DOUBLE PARKED (IRE)
  3. PER CONTRA (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
IVEAGH HOUSE just about sets the standard having finished fourth in a maiden that has worked out well and he can confirm form over Selosse, who shaped well in the same race. Several newcomers could be flies in the ointment, though, including Knight's Honour and True Sovereign from the same stable as the selection so the market needs a look.

  1. IVEAGH HOUSE (IRE)
  2. SELOSSE (IRE)
  3. KNIGHT'S HONOUR (IRE)

races.name: M.L.A Engineering Ltd. Supporting Ardclough GAA Maiden
races.verdict:
ZELANI took a big step forward when second at Listowel 19 days ago and, though he didn’t fully settle, is bred to be useful and remains open to improvement. Ridersinthesky returns from another lengthy absence but sets the standard and rates the main danger if giving her running, while Tax Me Later can also be involved if building on her recent yard debut.

  1. ZELANI (IRE)
  2. RIDERSINTHESKY (GER)
  3. TAX ME LATER (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Birdcatcher Premier Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
PINK VENOM has improved in leaps and bounds since switched to nurseries, winning at Fairyhouse and Cork, and is taken to complete the hat-trick despite a 10 lb rise. Equus Victor’s Gowran Park dead-heat form has worked out well, and he rates the main danger if bouncing back from a poor effort upped in grade last time. Lars Soldier won on handicap debut at Navan and is respected back in calmer waters.

  1. PINK VENOM (IRE)
  2. EQUUS VICTOR (IRE)
  3. LARS SOLDIER (IRE)

races.name: RFL Steels Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
In a listed race where few arrive with convincing claims it might be worth chancing the fitness of TWO STARS, who enjoyed his finest hour when landing a course listed event last spring and has gone well fresh before. Last year's winner Thunderbear shaped as if on the way back when fifth in a big-field handicap at the Curragh last month and is second choice ahead of Staysound Susie.

  1. TWO STARS (IRE)
  2. THUNDERBEAR (IRE)
  3. STAYSOUND SUSIE (IRE)

races.name: Naas Farm Machinery Handicap
races.verdict:
STAG NIGHT was significantly better than the result on his recent return from a break at the Curragh and is taken to land this race for the second year running. Keke is another who is likely in much better form than his last couple of efforts at the Curragh might suggest and is feared most ahead of Johnny Murtagh 3-y-o Bay of Supremacy, who may strip fitter for his recent first outing in 4 months.

  1. STAG NIGHT (IRE)
  2. KEKE
  3. BAY OF SUPREMACY (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
JUSTICIAR simply did too much too soon in blinkers when last seen and is given another chance back from a break with that headgear left off this time. Elmakaya and Therewillbeglory are the chief form threats, while Palace Fever can build on a promising opening run.

  1. JUSTICIAR (IRE)
  2. ELMAKAYA (IRE)
  3. THEREWILLBEGLORY (IRE)

races.name: Naas Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open. ZENFORD had looked on the up until his progress stalled when fourth at Leopardstown in July but he remains handily weighed and is taken to return from a break in style here. Back Down Under is feared most on the back of a very good Fairyhouse second, while City House, Storm Ready and Flash Of Fire all need factoring in too.

  1. ZENFORD (IRE)
  2. BACK DOWN UNDER (IRE)
  3. CITY HOUSE (IRE)

races.name: Winter Festival Early Bird Tickets On Sale Now Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
GLEN KILN achieved by far the best hurdles form of these and will take plenty of beating if taking to chasing. Manoir de Mirande doesn’t always find much but should be suited by the drop back to 2m, while Takenasred is entitled to fare better than on chasing bow.

  1. GLEN KILN (IRE)
  2. MANOIR DE MIRANDE (FR)
  3. TAKENASRED (IRE)

races.name: O'Neills.com Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
FORT DINO shaped as if amiss last time but had made an encouraging start in this sphere beforehand and will go close if returning to that level. Straight John looks likely to make a better chaser than hurdler and rates the main danger, while Walks The Talk should do better on the back of a promising return.

  1. FORT DINO (FR)
  2. STRAIGHT JOHN (FR)
  3. WALKS THE TALK (IRE)

races.name: Malone Windows Supporting Louth GAA Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ANODANDAWINK is firmly on the up and had a bit in hand when completing the hat-trick last time. A 9 lb rise asks more of him, but he remains unexposed and looks capable of making it 4 in a row. Pourquoi Poi improved when narrowly denied last time and rates the main danger, while the thriving, well-treated Smallcraftwarning and unexposed Jukebox Johnny are also respected.

  1. ANODANDAWINK (IRE)
  2. POURQUOI POI (IRE)
  3. SMALLCRAFTWARNING (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
ASH HOBBS cost a pretty penny after winning her point and, while she didn’t show much in bumpers, she should fare better now switched to hurdles. In what looks an ordinary affair, she is narrowly preferred to Marie D’Angos and The Hidden Kingdom, a pair of hurdling newcomers who make appeal on paper.

  1. ASH HOBBS (IRE)
  2. MARIE D'ANGOS (FR)
  3. THE HIDDEN KINGDOM (IRE)

races.name: Powerscreen New England Supporting Louth GAA Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ANNIE'S ANGEL was much improved when winning over C&D last time and is taken to defy a 7 lb rise faced with a similar scenario. Not In A Hurry has had just 2 starts but was a taking winner last time and should be firmly in the mix if improving for the switch to handicaps, while Might Be The One also arrives on the back of an improved success and may have more to offer.

  1. ANNIE'S ANGEL (IRE)
  2. NOT IN A HURRY (IRE)
  3. MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE)

races.name: Protection & Prosperity Financial Services Supporting Louth GAA Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
GRANLAHAN has been a model of consistency lately and is taken to gain a deserved first success from a still-workable mark. Jurality should be suited by the drop back in trip and rates the main threat if reproducing last month’s Navan effort, while Hesasmoothoperator and Chesterbaylad can also be involved at their best.

  1. GRANLAHAN (IRE)
  2. JURALITY
  3. HESASMOOTHOPERATOR (IRE)

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
GAELIC SEER shaped well on her first start when third in a Ballinrobe bumper (form has been franked) and can build on it to get off the mark here. John McConnell's Maxios newcomer Miss Kobe could emerge as the main danger, although Streamhill has the form to play a big part if on her A-game.

  1. GAELIC SEER (IRE)
  2. MISS KOBE (IRE)
  3. STREAMHILL (IRE)

Prix De La Forterelle Maiden Stakes
